content.question: How does KNN classify a new data point?
options: It finds the hyperplane that maximizes the margin between the classes.
It applies Bayes' theorem assuming all features are conditionally independent.
It assigns the majority class among the k nearest neighbours of the new point.
It fits a multivariate normal distribution to each class and picks the closest one.
content.answer: It assigns the majority class among the k nearest neighbours of the new point.
